reference.scope: Observed public symbol pays and line paths only; no provider probability or maximum-win reproduction. Provider help displayed 1000x; independent model maximum is 5000x.

author: Superwin operator
disclosure: Independent Superwin probabilities: base RTP 96%, maximum base win 5000x total stake. Uniform independent cells; longest left-to-right match pays once per line. Optional color gamble wins 2x with probability 1/2. RTP is a long-run expectation, not a promised session return. Not SmartSoft probability math.
